summary: Correct the manual upgrade steps for daily iOS Fabric delivery from #5492 (hosted as #5607); the original fragment's manual status of none was incorrect.

compatibility.detail: Release-note correction only; no client or wire protocol change.

downtime.detail: No service interruption; this fragment does not deploy or change a device.

manual.detail: Before scheduled delivery uses the merged release_delivery.py, repin ST_IOS_SCRIPT in the delivery environment to that merged script. Prefer deleting the ST_IOS_SCRIPT and ST_IOS_REF overrides so the documented defaults apply. Ensure the Mac builder has both Rust targets installed: aarch64-apple-ios and aarch64-apple-ios-sim. The pending toolchain PR makes these targets repo-owned; until it lands, the operator must provide both targets on the builder.

recovery.detail: No recovery behavior change; existing delivery approval and monotonic version protections remain unchanged.
